resources.string: Let Android reserve the panel strip (experimental)
Let Android reserve the panel strip?

Experimental, and not yet verified on a head unit.

Android itself will lay out every window of the central display beside the left panel, instead of Controls moving each app there. Running apps restart once. Factory screens that already leave room for the panel may show a doubled gap.

If the system process restarts while this is on, Controls turns it off by itself. You can turn it off here at any time.
Stop reserving the panel strip?
Android returns to its own layout and running apps restart once. Controls then places managed apps beside the panel again, as before.
Requested. Android applies it within a few seconds.
Android no longer reserves the panel strip.
Saved. It takes effect once the window service is running.
The window service agent on this head unit does not support the option yet. Reconnect in Buttons to update it.
